'''''Études of Time and Space''''' was a piece of [[Music/Legends|music]] written by the [[Fondorian]] composer, [[Metrisse]],<ref name="Shadows" /> before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> He wrote the music while he stayed at [[Poloda Place]], an apartment complex on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Shadows" /> By the year [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the piece of music was famous. When the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Den Dhur]] was in the complex around that [[Time/Legends|time]], he thought of ''Études of Time and Space'' while reflecting upon the number of artistic individuals who had lived in Poloda Place.<ref name="Shadows" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Études of Time and Space'' was mentioned in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]].<ref name="Shadows" />
